title: RTU Hall of Fame
subtitle: Celebrating Excellence and Innovation
description: These Accolades Wall of Fame winners were selected as the best of the best by their peers. We appreciate these star performers and their efforts in making RTU a high-performing university.

inductees.name: Dr. Elena Rostova
inductees.bio: Dr. Rostova has pioneered groundbreaking research in autonomous UAV exploration and mapping, leading to the development of the AeroVision framework. Her work has significantly advanced our understanding of automated environmental surveying.

inductees.name: Prof. Marcus Vance
inductees.bio: A cornerstone of the Computer Science faculty for over two decades, Professor Vance has mentored thousands of students. His visionary approach to curriculum development has kept RTU at the bleeding edge of technology education.

inductees.name: Julian Sterling
inductees.bio: As the founder of VoltPath, Julian has revolutionized battery routing and telemetry optimization. He continues to give back to the university by sponsoring the annual Global Hackathon and providing scholarships to aspiring engineers.
